units.title: Food
units.theme: Fruit, Food, Requests, Likes and Dislikes
units.notes: Covers fruit vocabulary, counting with 'How many...?', preference grammar ('I like... / I don't like...'), food and drink nouns, polite requests ('Can I have some..., please? / Yes, here you go. / No, sorry!'), fable 'Fox and Stork' (being considerate), breakfast culture in Türkiye and Vietnam, contraction focus (don't = do not), a shopping role-play project, and review.

continuous_text.title: The Noodles Song
continuous_text.content:
Can I have some noodles, please?
Can I have some noodles, please?
Can I have some noodles, please?
Yes, here you go!

I don't like ice cream.
I don't like soup.
I like pizza. I like juice.
I like pizza. I like juice.
But my favorite food is noodles.
continuous_text.notes: Audio tracks 162 and 163. Includes substitution words: mangoes, salad.

continuous_text.title: Fox and Stork
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1
Narrator: This is Fox's house.
Fox: Hello, Stork. Come in!
Stork: Hello, Fox.

Frame 2
Narrator: Fox has some soup.
Stork: I'm hungry. Can I have some soup, please?
Fox: Yes, here you go.

Frame 3
Narrator: Oh, no!
Stork: I can't eat my soup.

Frame 4
Narrator: Poor Stork!
Stork: Goodbye!
Fox: Bye!

Frame 5
Narrator: This is Stork's house.
Stork: Hello, Fox. Come in!
Fox: Hello, Stork.

Frame 6
Narrator: Stork has some orange juice.
Fox: I'm thirsty. Can I have some orange juice, please?
Stork: Yes, here you go.

Frame 7
Narrator: Oh, no!
Fox: Oh! I can't drink my juice.

Frame 8
Narrator: Poor Fox!
Fox: Goodbye!
Stork: Bye!
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 4 Story spanning pages 102 and 103. Traditional Aesop fable exploring consideration and empathy.

continuous_text.title: Breakfast in My Country
continuous_text.content:
I'm Duong. I'm from Vietnam. Today I have my favorite breakfast. It's pho. Pho is soup. It has some noodles in it. It's very good! I have some juice, too. It's mango juice.
I like mango juice and I like orange juice, but I don't like apple juice. Coconut juice is my favorite!
I don't like cheese for breakfast, but I like bread. I like eggs and salad, too.
What's your favorite breakfast?
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 5 Reading passage formatted as a personal account of breakfast.
